title: National CPI inflation, 1 and 2 years ahead

design.backtest: rolling origin, expanding window; train on rows with target year <= origin
design.selection_rule: lowest validation MAE (log scale) at h=1
design.intervals: Mondrian split conformal on log-scale absolute errors; rolling 10-year calibration window; bins by origin inflation [4.0, 10.0]

features.name: infl_lag0
features.description: CPI inflation in the origin year (slog)

features.name: infl_lag1
features.description: CPI inflation one year before the origin (slog)

features.name: infl_lag2
features.description: CPI inflation two years before the origin (slog)

features.name: infl_mean5
features.description: Mean of slog inflation over the last 5 years

features.name: infl_std5
features.description: Std. dev. of slog inflation over the last 5 years

features.name: infl_change
features.description: Change in slog inflation over the origin year

features.name: deflator_lag0
features.description: GDP-deflator inflation in the origin year (slog)

features.name: money_growth_lag0
features.description: Broad money growth in the origin year (slog)

features.name: money_growth_lag1
features.description: Broad money growth one year before (slog)

features.name: fx_change_lag0
features.description: Depreciation vs USD over the origin year, % (slog)

features.name: gdp_growth_lag0
features.description: Real GDP growth in the origin year, %

features.name: unemployment_lag0
features.description: Unemployment rate in the origin year, %

features.name: real_interest_lag0
features.description: Real lending rate in the origin year (slog)

features.name: current_account_lag0
features.description: Current account balance, % of GDP

features.name: debt_lag0
features.description: General government gross debt, % of GDP

features.name: log_trade_openness
features.description: log of trade (exports + imports) as % of GDP

features.name: log_gdp_pc_ppp
features.description: log GDP per capita at PPP (level of development)

features.name: global_infl_median
features.description: Cross-country median slog inflation, origin year

features.name: global_infl_change
features.description: Change in the cross-country median over the year

features.name: region_code
features.description: World Bank region (categorical)

models.name: Naive (random walk)
models.description: Inflation h years ahead equals inflation in the latest year.

models.name: Three-year mean
models.description: Mean of (signed-log) inflation over the latest three years.

models.name: Pooled AR(3) ridge
models.description: Linear regression on three inflation lags and the global median, pooled across countries; the classical econometric benchmark.

models.name: LightGBM (inflation history only)
models.description: Gradient-boosted trees on inflation-history and global features only. An ablation that isolates the value of the macro-financial features.

models.name: LightGBM global panel model
models.description: One gradient-boosted tree model for all countries on inflation history, money growth, exchange-rate depreciation, output, labour, fiscal and structural features.

models.name: Ensemble (pooled AR + LightGBM)
models.description: Equal-weight average of the pooled AR(3) and the global LightGBM model, combining a stable linear forecast with a non-linear one that uses macro drivers.

intended_use: Indicative, transparent baseline forecasts of headline CPI inflation for public-interest analysis and for the purchasing-power tools on the site.
limitations: Annual data only: the model cannot see monthly inflation releases, so it reacts to shocks a year later than a central-bank nowcast would.
Data for year t is published during year t+1, so the 1-year-ahead forecast is effectively a current-year estimate.
Hyperinflation episodes are rare in training data; intervals in the >10% regime are wide by design and point forecasts there should not be relied on.
No structural information (policy rates, commodity prices, elections). Large policy regime changes are not anticipated.
Historical IMF WEO vintages are not freely downloadable by script, so the IMF comparison is side-by-side for current forecasts, not a backtest.
not_intended_for: Countries with fewer than three years of recent inflation history.
